# docs-host-vault-agent-modules-routing

Agent-module routing notes — direct prior art for the harness/driver registry.

## Why this matters

Direct prior art for the harness/driver registry. Holds the canon catalog and the TS-runtime-gap map that motivated the Elixir control-plane consolidation.

- `host/EMA-v1.1-Next-Steps/01-PLANS/2026-04-13-DAEMON-EXTRACTION-IMPL-NOTES.md` — daemon extraction implementation notes
